props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: conversion
props.description: Shows the conversion rate from the previous stage (default `true`)

props.name: sort
props.description: Order of the stages (default `none`: the data order)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the stages: trapezoids narrowing to the next stage, or centered bars (default `trapezoid`)

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: data
props.description: Stages: a name, a value and an optional color

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: gap
props.description: Vertical gap between the stages, in pixels (default 4)

<script setup lang="ts">
// `shape="bar"` draws centered bars, `sort="descending"` orders the stages
// by value.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { FunnelChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: ["Interviews", "Applications", "Offers", "Screenings", "Hires"],
  zh: ["面试", "申请", "录用通知", "筛选", "入职"],
  ja: ["面接", "応募", "内定", "書類選考", "採用"],
  fr: ["Entretiens", "Candidatures", "Offres", "Présélections", "Embauches"],
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() =>
  [180, 940, 42, 410, 31].map((value, i) => ({
    name: (TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en)[i],
    value,
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <FunnelChart :data="data" shape="bar" sort="descending" :height="300" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// Stages narrow to the next one; the labels show the conversion rate from
// the previous stage.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { FunnelChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: ["Visits", "Sign-ups", "Trials", "Purchases"],
  zh: ["访问", "注册", "试用", "购买"],
  ja: ["訪問", "登録", "トライアル", "購入"],
  fr: ["Visites", "Inscriptions", "Essais", "Achats"],
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() =>
  [12000, 4800, 2100, 860].map((value, i) => ({
    name: (TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en)[i],
    value,
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <FunnelChart :data="data" :height="300" />
</template>

translationResources.title: Funnel chart
translationResources.description: Stages of a process that lose volume along the way (sign-ups, sales pipeline, checkout), with the conversion rate from each stage to the next. Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a stage; click a legend item to hide it.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Trapezoids narrow to the next stage and show the conversion rate; renderTooltip adds the share of visitors and the drop-off in React.

bars.title: Bars and sorting
bars.description: shape="bar" draws centered bars for values that are not a sequence; sort orders them (animated) and conversion={false} hides the rates.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce checkout
ecommerce.description: A shop's checkout funnel next to a Table of the drop-off between stages; the stage that loses the most visitors is highlighted in red in both.

recruiting.title: Hiring pipeline
recruiting.description: Candidates of one role from application to hire as bars with one color per stage; the tooltip adds the typical time spent in the stage and a click selects it.

compare.title: Comparing segments
compare.description: The same funnel split by device, side by side with the same stages and one color per segment, to see where mobile users drop out.

campaigns.title: Marketing funnel by channel
campaigns.description: A Select filters the funnel to one acquisition channel and the stages animate to the new counts. renderTooltip adds the conversion from the previous stage and the cost per result, computed from the channel's spend; the line below gives the customer acquisition cost.

what-if.title: What-if conversion model
what-if.description: The −1 / +1 buttons change the conversion rate of one checkout step and the funnel is recomputed from the visits; the summary compares the orders and the revenue with today's rates. Rates are kept in whole percent points so that Reset knows when nothing has changed.

live-sale.title: Live flash sale
live-sale.description: A one-hour sale replayed in 30 ticks (setInterval, cleared on pause, at the end and on unmount): new visitors arrive and move down the stages with a seeded random generator. The status line follows the clock, and only the end of the sale is announced.

sales-pipeline.title: B2B sales pipeline
sales-pipeline.description: Stages sized by the amount of their open deals, with conversion={false} because each stage holds different deals. onClick lists the deals of a stage next to the funnel, and renderTooltip shows their count and win probability.

props.hideConversion: Hides the conversion rates from the previous stage

props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
